poznote 6.97.1 brings full offline support! 📝

Notes are cached in your browser so you can read, edit, and create them offline. Changes auto-sync when your connection returns. You can pin specific notes offline and configure retention (default 5 days).

Also adds a 'Shared with me' view.

Release: https://github.com/timothepoznanski/poznote/releases/tag/6.97.1
Run on PikaPods: https://pikapods.com/pods?run=poznote

#opensource #selfhosted #privacy
